content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Residential property insurer underwriting homeowner policies; the target is an office landlord leasing space to businesses."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Sells advertising on billboards and transit displays; the target earns rent from leasing office buildings."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate tenants in US metros, matching the target's office-landlord model."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Provides mechanical, electrical and plumbing services for building owners; the target owns and leases office property."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Mechanical and electrical contractor installing building systems; the target is a property owner collecting office rent."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Owns senior housing and medical properties rather than office buildings, though it also leases space to operators."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Owns upscale hotels and resorts earning guest room and banquet revenue, not long-term office leases."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Owns logistics warehouses and distribution centers leased to logistics and retail tenants, not office space."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Operates self-storage facilities renting units to consumers and small businesses, not office space to corporate tenants."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Owns and franchises select-service hotels earning nightly room revenue from travelers."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Operates a hotel and apartment complexes plus securities investments; no office leasing business."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Earns management fees by providing property and advisory services to REITs; it does not own or lease office buildings."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Develops and sells land, homes and timber, and runs resorts in Northwest Florida; not an office leasing business."}]}
